scripts.build: bun run build:truck && bun run check:sizes && bun run build:truck-web && bun run build:docs
scripts.build:sync: cd systems/sync/crate && wasm-pack build --target web --release && rm -rf ../../truck/web/pkg-sync && mv pkg ../../truck/web/pkg-sync && wasm-pack build --target bundler --release && rm -rf ../../truck/worker/pkg-sync && mv pkg ../../truck/worker/pkg-sync
scripts.build:truck: bun run build:sync && cd systems/truck/crate && wasm-pack build --target web --release && rm -rf ../web/pkg-browser-renderer && mv pkg ../web/pkg-browser-renderer && cargo run --bin generate-schema 2>/dev/null > ../cad-schema.json && cd ../../.. && bun run gen:adapters
scripts.build:truck-web: bun run gen:api-types && cd systems/truck/web && bun run build
scripts.build:docs: bun scripts/build-llm-docs.ts && cd systems/docs/website && bun install --silent && bun run build
scripts.typecheck: cd systems/truck/worker && bunx tsc --noEmit && cd ../web && bun run typecheck
scripts.test:crate: cargo test -p truck-webgpu-gui --no-default-features --features native --test schema_contract && cargo test -p truck-sync && cargo test --release -p truck-webgpu-gui --no-default-features --features native
scripts.test:api: cd systems/truck/worker && bun x vitest run
scripts.test:api:watch: cd systems/truck/worker && bun x vitest watch
scripts.test:e2e: cd systems/truck/tests && bun x playwright test
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:e2e
